title: Calories in national dishes: 22 cuisines compared (2026 data) | Pofu
desc: How calorie-dense are typical dishes from 22 cuisines? Calories per serving and per 100 g for {n} local dishes, with the median for each cuisine and a free CSV download.
h1: Calories in national dishes: 22 cuisines compared
lede: We compared the calories in {n} typical local dishes from 22 cuisines, from Turkish lentil soup to Korean bibimbap, per serving and per 100 g.
find_top: In our sample, {top} dishes are the most calorie-dense, with a median of {topk} kcal per 100 g.
find_low: {low} dishes are the lightest, with a median of {lowk} kcal per 100 g.
find_soup: Soups and vegetable dishes are the lightest dishes in most cuisines, while fried dishes, pastries and sweets are the most calorie-dense.
find_portion: Calories per 100 g and calories per serving tell different stories: a light dish eaten in a big bowl can add up to more than a small, dense pastry.
method: Dishes: the local dishes on our food pages for each language, chosen as common, well-known dishes of that cuisine. Drinks, sauces and small side portions (under 60 g or 80 kcal a serving) are left out. It is a sample, not a full picture of what people in a country eat.

Values: from public food composition databases (USDA FoodData Central, NEVO, the Swedish Food Agency, NutriDatabáze, CREA) and the Pofu app’s food database. Each dish page links its source where one exists.
Median: the middle value of the dishes’ calories per 100 g, so one very heavy or very light dish doesn’t move the result much. Cuisines with fewer than 8 dishes in our sample are marked.

Limits: recipes, portions and cooking oil differ by home, region and restaurant, so every value is a typical estimate. Variants of one dish (for example with chicken or shrimp) are counted separately.
cite: You may use this data with a link to this page.
faq: Which cuisine has the most calorie-dense dishes?
In our sample of {n} dishes, {top} dishes have the highest median, about {topk} kcal per 100 g. Recipes vary a lot, so treat it as a rough comparison.
Which cuisine has the lightest dishes?
{low} dishes have the lowest median in our sample, about {lowk} kcal per 100 g, mostly because soups, stews and steamed dishes contain a lot of water.
Does calorie density decide if a dish is healthy?
No. It shows how many calories fit in a given amount of food. Protein, fiber, vegetables and portion size matter just as much.
How do I count calories for a home-cooked national dish?
Start from a typical value like the ones here, then adjust the portion to what you ate. In Pofu you can take a photo of your plate and correct the estimate.
